Content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced Thursday that Ukraine agrees to an "immediate ceasefire" and is prepared to enter negotiations for a lasting peace agreement with Russia. Title: Ukraine agrees to US ceasefire proposal, enters peace negotiations
